## Validation and limitations

No relevant articles were supplied. The search found 11 eligible records in a screened pilot: eight development records and three held-out validation records. Relative recall was **100% (8/8)** in development and **100% (3/3)** in the held-out set. The held-out set came from the same screened pilot, so this is semi-independent validation, not a sensitivity estimate.

The optional PK/exposure/efficacy block reduced results from 4,322 to 1,652; none of 30 sampled excluded records met eligibility. That sample does not prove the full excluded set contains no relevant records. The standalone `bispecific` term broadens retrieval and contributes noise; population and study-design criteria are left for screening.

The draft **needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**. The automated critic passed, but it is not human PRESS peer review.
